newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Lernout to buy Belgian translation firm.
newsitem.headline: Lernout to buy Belgian translation firm.

text.p: Belgium's Lernout & Hauspie Speech Products NV said it agreed to buy privately-held Brussels-based firm Mendez Translations for $16.9 million.
It will be financed through cash-in-hand, existing bank credit lines and a convertible bond, Lernout & Hauspie said in a statement.

"Combining Mendez's large translation (skills) with Lernout & Hauspie's natural language processing will assist us in developing fully automatic translation applications," the company's president Jo Lernout said in a statement.
Examples of such applications were multilingual Internet search engines, software for automatic translation of Internet documents and human translation services via e-mail, he said.
Mendez Translations has subsidiaries in France, Germany, Spain and will soon have a branch in Italy, the statement said.
It added the company was profitable with estimated sales of over $15 million for the current year.
Mendez currently performs translation activities in French, Italian, Greek, Spanish, Portuguese and Dutch with customers that include Microsoft, Compaq Computers and Texas Instruments.

Lernout & Hauspie is a leading company in the development of speech technology for commercial products in the telecommunications, computers, mulitmedia, automotive electronics and consumer electronics sectors.
